name: Mounted Assault (Su)
body:
Prerequisite: Magus 6

Benefit: The magus can expend 1 point from his arcane pool as a swift action to summon a mount for himself. This functions as phantom steed, with the magus automatically mounted. Only the magus can ride the steed, and it lasts a number of minutes equal to his Intelligence modifier.
